items.title: Lennar (LEN) Faces Class Action Lawsuit Over Millrose Spin Off
items.summary: Lennar (NYSE:LEN) has been named in a new class action lawsuit alleging misleading conduct related to its Millrose spin off. Plaintiffs claim Lennar misrepresented how its operating strategy and Millrose structure affected reported financial performance and home sale activity. The suit alleges Millrose was used in a way that artificially supported Lennar home sales metrics presented to investors.
